Sponsor: Thermal Grizzly Duronaut on Amazon - https://geni.us/tpgcPMw
Steve joins Steve to thank Steve, and then Steve asks Steve if all the other Steves are F'd, or if it's just these particular Steves. We mostly talk about the state of the industry and how everything is in the worst spot that we've ever seen it, including the diversion of supply to AI, the seemingly fake circles of money, and the loss of scaling progress in consumer hardware leading to what feels like abandonment by companies.
